name: m15_prbs
notes: Residual coherence multiplies the coherent crosstalk terms of m15_coherent. Delays from 2 to 15 bits (integer, or arbitrary in steps of 0.37 bit). Cross-term low-frequency density in units of 1/B.

inputs.modulation: common phase modulation of the seed before the 1:16 split; per-chip fibre delays
inputs.B: symbol rate (binary, Zadoff-Chu) or inverse correlation time (Gaussian noise)
inputs.objective_chromatic: 16 um/nm axial (diffractive), lateral x proportional to lambda
